name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2026-01-03, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.85 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
